AUTHORIZATION_DENIED: You do not have permission to perform this action.
CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: This record has been modified by someone else. Please refresh and try again.
RATE_LIMITED: Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.
FEATURE_DISABLED: This feature is disabled on this instance.
SIGNATURE_MODULE_DISABLED: The e-signature module is not enabled on this instance.
SIGNATURE_CONNECTION_NOT_AVAILABLE: No signature provider connection is available for this operation.
PROVIDER_NOT_CONNECTED: No enabled signature provider connection is available, so no request can be sent.
PROVIDER_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The provider may have accepted the request but no confirmation was received. The request is held for reconciliation and has not been sent again.
SIGNATURE_REQUEST_INVALID_STATE: The signature request is not in a state that allows this action.
SIGNATURE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This signature request needs an approval before it can be sent.
RECIPIENT_NOT_AUTHORIZED: That recipient is not part of this signature request.
SIGNATURE_DOCUMENT_NOT_READABLE: The document for this signature request cannot be read.
SIGNATURE_SOURCE_RECORD_NOT_READABLE: The record linked to this signature request cannot be read.
NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_PROVIDER: The signature provider does not support this operation in this release.
ENCRYPTION_KEY_MISSING: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not configured, so provider credentials cannot be read and no provider operation is possible.
